name: H na Kuni no Alice-chan
source:
Alice appears in a strange world with her pants stolen by a suspicious rabbit. She will need to overcome numerous trials before she can get her pants back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
爱丽丝出现在一个陌生的世界，她的裤子被一只可疑的兔子偷走了。她需要克服重重考验才能拿回裤子。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
